system.description:
Placing a single, sheathed sword upright and listening to the "breath" of your opponent, you rapidly unsheathe, attack while passing by your target, and then re-sheathe your sword. Make a melee taijutsu Attack against a creature in range. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon’s damage] +3d8.

Chain 1: If your attack result is 5 or more higher than your opponent’s AC, they cannot take a Reaction until the end of the current turn.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
